mapper.select: SELECT user_financial_profile_id, user_id, annual_income, income_type, employment_status, credit_score, liquid_asset_amount, created_at, updated_at FROM user_financial_profile WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_financial_profile( user_id, annual_income, income_type, employment_status, credit_score, liquid_asset_amount ) VALUES( #{userId}, #{annualIncome}, #{incomeType}, #{employmentStatus}, #{creditScore}, #{liquidAssetAmount} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE user_financial_profile
annual_income = #{annualIncome},
income_type = #{incomeType},
employment_status = #{employmentStatus},
credit_score = #{creditScore},
liquid_asset_amount = #{liquidAssetAmount},
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
